{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Mock-neck knit: fitted, hip length, dusty blue (#7F93A8), fine merino wool
Trousers: straight leg, high rise, ankle length, charcoal (#3B3F47), wool-blend flannel
Jacket: single-breasted blazer, hip length, deep navy (#26334D), textured wool herringbone
Coat: straight cut, mid-calf length, with a storm collar, deep burgundy (#5B2A3A), insulated wool-blend with a water-repellent finish
Socks: knee-high, charcoal (#3B3F47), thermal merino wool
Ankle boots: low block heel, grippy lug sole, black (#1F1D20), waterproof treated leather that wipes clean of road salt
Scarf: long and wide, soft grey-blue (#A9B4C2), brushed wool
Beanie: close-fitting, ribbed, charcoal (#3B3F47), wool with a fleece lining
Gloves: black (#1F1D20), cashmere-lined leather
Tote: structured, with a zip top, black (#1F1D20), grained leather

Why it works: The knit, trousers and textured blazer form a neat business look for the office. The insulated mid-calf coat, thermal socks, scarf, hat and gloves keep you warm through a 20-minute walk in deep frost and snow. The waterproof grippy boots handle slippery pavements and salt, and they look polished enough to wear all day. The dusty blue and navy echo your eyes and sit softly against your fair skin and dark hair, while the burgundy coat adds a warm, rich contrast."}
